en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Range of the subject allows to carry out time-consuming work in laboratory. Work is related to determination of some content components, preserving agents, eventually confirmation of technological operation effectivity.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Sterilized vegetables preparation - preparation, calculation of infusion, sterilising. (allowance 0/3)2.Compote preparation - material composition of fruits, preparation, calculation of infusion, sterilising. (allowance 0/3)3.Vegetable in salt preparation - vegetable preparation, calculation of salt, checking of salt content by titration. (allowance 0/3)4.Preparation of preservatized semifinished material - determination of SO2 concentration in H2SO3, pickle preparation, calculation of preservative dosagechecking of SO2 content in homogenate. (allowance 0/3)5.Blanching of vegetables - precooking in different bath varieties, checking of enzymatic activity, evaluation of termal treatment - proposal for optimal time of blanching. en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Full-time study: Preparation, submission and acceptance of the protocols from the laboratory exercise and a minimum of 75 % and a credit test. Written test: technological computational relationships - 50 minute written test during the block (must receive a minimum of 40 points out of a maximum of 60) Part-time (Distance) Learning: Credit - 70% attendance at block events, submission and acceptance of block event reports with a minimum of 75% and a credit test. Written test: technological computational relationships - 50 minute written test during the block (must receive a minimum of 40 points out of a maximum of 60)
